title: VIXEN ready-fence waits need an approved no-mutex completion primitive
body: The first fence helper used a mutex/condition variable, but the repository no-new-mutex gate rejected the new header; the implementation had to hand-build an atomic copy-on-write failure ledger plus polling wait. The facade/build rules should provide or approve a shared completion primitive so each lane does not invent a lock-free substitute.

title: AppFlow MCP transport timeout must exceed bounded preview waits
body: The channel exposed a wait_recipe_preview timeout up to 60000 ms, but the stdio MCP adapter defaulted to 45 seconds; the witness hit the adapter timeout before the editor could return ready/timedOut. The adapter and channel gate should derive one shared transport/application timeout contract.
